speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) whether the Government takes into account a shared bicycle operator's ability to meet financial obligations to staff, vendors and the public when considering licensing status; (b) when a licence is cancelled, whether any monies from security deposits and licence fees are made available for claims by vendors, employees and the general public; and (c) if so, what order or process shall apply to determine claim entitlements.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: If none of these circumstances arise, LTA will not make a claim on the security deposit.

The following question was moved earlier –  Assoc Prof Walter Theseira asked the Minister for Transport (a) whether the Government takes into account a shared bicycle operator's ability to meet financial obligations to staff, vendors and the public when considering licensing status; (b) when a licence is cancelled, whether any monies from security deposits and licence fees are made available for claims by vendors, employees and the general public; and (c) if so, what order or process shall apply to determine claim entitlements.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira, do you want to follow up?

speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
text: First, I just want to clarify from the Senior Minister of State that regarding the security deposit, other than statutory purposes laid out in the Parking Places Act, is the Senior Minister of State saying that any remaining sums will be forfeited into the Consolidated Fund and will not be available to any private claims?

speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
text: Then, I have a supplementary question in general.

speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
text: As we know, this is a regulated activity which forms an important first- and last-mile link in our public transport system.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min)
text: Based on the current Parking Places Act, the purpose is as laid out in the reply that I have alluded to just now.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min)
text: With regard to the Member's subsequent question, we have started this licensing regime for bicycle sharing operators very recently.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min)
text: In fact, we have only started this for a couple of months and we are actually looking at how this will pan out.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min)
text: If you look at the current situation, since the implementation of this licensing regime, there has been some improvement.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min)
text: But we are still closely monitoring this situation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min)
text: And we hope that, with time, we will be able to see whether we need to make adjustments in order to accommodate what Assoc Prof Walter Theseira has suggested.
